rules.title: Renewable energy project eligibility
rules.logic: Project must install new renewable energy capacity. Grid-connected or off-grid systems both eligible. Fossil fuel displacement required.

rules.title: Project design document requirements
rules.logic: PDD must describe technology, capacity factor, grid connection, and emission reduction methodology per GS-VER1 requirements.

rules.title: Safeguards and stakeholder consultation
rules.logic: Project must conduct stakeholder consultation and assess environmental and social impacts per GS4GG safeguards requirements.

rules.title: Baseline scenario determination
rules.logic: Baseline is the grid emission factor for the host country. Use latest approved grid emission factor data from Gold Standard or CDM sources.

rules.title: Additionality demonstration
rules.logic: Additionality must be demonstrated using the GS additionality tool. Investment analysis and barrier analysis required.

rules.title: Common practice analysis
rules.logic: Common practice analysis must demonstrate the project technology is not widespread in the host country context.

rules.title: Emission reduction quantification
rules.logic: Net emission reductions = baseline emissions - project emissions - leakage. Use approved grid emission factor and project-specific generation data.

rules.title: Leakage assessment
rules.logic: Assess activity shifting and market leakage. Market leakage is de minimis for most renewable energy projects.

rules.title: Monitoring plan requirements
rules.logic: Monitoring plan must cover electricity generation data, grid emission factor updates, and safeguard indicators per GS monitoring requirements.

rules.title: Data and parameters monitored
rules.logic: All monitored data parameters must be recorded, archived for minimum 2 years after crediting period, and made available for verification.

rules.title: Sustainable Development (SDG) contribution
rules.logic: Project must demonstrate contribution to at least three SDGs. SDG impact report required per GS4GG requirements.
